report.incident_summary: A controlled CPU test on a temporary EC2 instance showed a single CPU measurement sample of 0.06%, well below the 90% threshold. No immediate concern is indicated, but the limited data and test nature mean that we cannot establish the severity or root cause with high confidence.

severity_rationale.statement: The CPU usage was well below the 90% threshold, indicating no immediate concern. However, the limited data and the nature of the test mean that we cannot establish the severity or root cause with high confidence.

potential_root_causes.statement: The low CPU usage could be due to the controlled nature of the test, which was not intended to stress the system.
The single sample may not be representative of typical usage patterns.

uncertainty: Limited data from a controlled test.
Thresholds are demo heuristics, not service SLOs.
Samples do not establish a root cause.
recommended_steps: Continue monitoring the instance for any changes in CPU usage.
Consider running additional tests with varied loads to gather more data.
Review the test methodology to ensure it aligns with the intended objectives.
additional_information_required: More CPU usage samples over time.
Details on the test methodology and objectives.
Any changes in the instance configuration or environment during the test.

limitations: CPU averages only; no memory, application logs or deployment events collected.
EC2 inventory does not identify which application is installed or running.
